description: LightGroup surface not shown even when a left-light show flag is driven in the harness. The resident-card light group's visibility is ultimately gated by sta_residentCardShow, which is CARD_LIGHTGROUP(2) only when val_residentCard==CARD_LIGHTGROUP; val_residentCard is hard-coded to 1 (CARD_CURRENTTIME) under the ALWASYS_SHOW_UI else-branch at diAEControl.cpp L122 and never assigned any other value. sta_residentCardShow therefore can never equal CARD_LIGHTGROUP and the LightGroup Draw/SetData body early-returns without a texture, making the surface undrivable to a true SHOW through the can[]/mem[]/someip harness. This case drives the available light-show inputs to their active values and asserts the negative label, explicitly documenting the undrivable condition.
